sections.title: Employment Contract
sections.text:
Indra, member of the Glasgow Gang, will gladly brawl with the big guys for you.

She is good at negotiating with her fists.

sections.title: Token
sections.text: A can of salted licorice with a long shelf life. Under that inaccessible appearance is an even more inaccessible taste.

sections.title: Profile
sections.text: The leader of the Glasgow Gang's fighters in Victoria. During the war, she fought courageously alongside Vina Victoria and the Exemplars. After the war, she returned to Norport to continue running the Slobberknocker boxing gym. As one of our main points of contact at Rhodes Island's Victoria office, she is often invited to participate in practical combat training (essentially serving as a sparring partner) and occasionally helps Vina Victoria deliver messages back to Rhodes Island.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
No visible Originium crystals have been observed on the surface of Indra's body. Though her disease is currently under control, she needs to be closely monitored.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Indra was injured during operations in Victoria, and became infected after long-term exposure to high levels of Originium particulate concentration.
After the war, she repeatedly refused the specialized physical exams prepared by Medical. Instead, she directed her colleagues, who had come to volunteer as medics, to treat local citizens first. At least three colleagues have raised objections to her indifference towards her own health.
'Tons of Londiniers who need help more than I do. 'Sides, I have to book a checkup at some point, else Vina'll duff me up. Again.'
——Operator Indra's reply

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text: Technique was not allowed her to survive for years on the street, but rather raw force and combat instincts. She developed into a great fighter through street brawling since childhood, and her confidence in her own two powerful fists enabled her to defeat countless foes.

sections.title: Archive File 2
sections.text: Glasgow hung out in the slums of Victoria, getting their start as a street gang led by Morgan and Indra. They carved out their turf and survived in the anarchy, until Siege showed up and handed the supremely confident Indra her first ever defeat.

sections.title: Archive File 3
sections.text: It wasn't just a simple defeat, since Siege's character and vision converted both Indra and Morgan into loyal friends and cohorts. Even though Siege never liked to pull rank, Indra still saw herself as Siege's most devoted follower and would do anything for her. Who knew a thug too lazy to be bothered with the concept of knighthood would exemplify the spirit far more than the official knights of Kazimierz?

sections.title: Archive File 4
sections.text: The straightforward Indra hates sly, glib people who play games. Face to face, out in the open, that's what fighting is all about! Only cowards would act like a weasel! Her bold personality has made many like-minded colleagues her buddies at Rhodes Island. They would spar and discuss battles in the gym, then go for a big feast together after a sweaty workout and mock the supposedly 'brainy' Operators behind their backs. What else could be better than this in life?
